## Summary
**As a** system architect, **I want** to determine appropriate metrics to be generated by all system components **so that** we can monitor performance, diagnose issues, and ensure the system meets operational and service-level objectives.

### Vision
The vision for this documentation is to identify a comprehensive set of metrics for each system component, enabling real-time monitoring, proactive alerting, and insightful analysis to maintain reliability, performance, and scalability.

### Background
System metrics are essential for understanding the health and performance of each component, identifying bottlenecks, and troubleshooting issues. Defining a standard set of metrics ensures consistency and completeness in monitoring.

### Purpose
The purpose of this documentation is to provide a detailed list of key metrics for all system components, categorized by functionality and relevance, to establish a robust monitoring framework.

## Metrics for System Components

### 1. **Application Components**
| **Component**            | **Metric Name**               | **Description**                                       | **Purpose**                                          |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **API Gateway**           | Request Count                | Total number of API requests received.               | Monitor usage and identify traffic patterns.        |
|                           | Latency (p95, p99)           | Time taken to respond to requests.                   | Detect slowdowns and ensure SLA compliance.         |
|                           | Error Rate                   | Percentage of 4xx and 5xx responses.                 | Identify application-level issues.                  |
| **Web/Mobile Applications**| Page Load Time              | Time taken to load web/mobile application pages.      | Measure user experience and performance.            |
|                           | Active Sessions              | Number of concurrent user sessions.                  | Understand system load and capacity needs.          |

### 2. **Backend Components**
| **Component**            | **Metric Name**               | **Description**                                       | **Purpose**                                          |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **Databases**             | Query Latency                | Time taken to execute database queries.               | Identify slow queries and optimize performance.      |
|                           | Connection Pool Utilization   | Percentage of used database connections.              | Avoid connection pool exhaustion.                   |
|                           | Cache Hit Ratio               | Ratio of cache hits to total queries.                 | Optimize caching strategy.                          |
| **Message Queues**        | Queue Depth                  | Number of messages waiting in the queue.              | Monitor backlog and processing delays.              |
|                           | Message Processing Time       | Time taken to process each message.                   | Ensure timely message handling.                     |

### 3. **Infrastructure Components**
| **Component**            | **Metric Name**               | **Description**                                       | **Purpose**                                          |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **Servers/VMs**           | CPU Utilization               | Percentage of CPU used.                               | Detect resource bottlenecks.                        |
|                           | Memory Utilization            | Percentage of memory used.                            | Avoid out-of-memory errors.                         |
|                           | Disk I/O                     | Number of read/write operations per second.           | Monitor storage performance.                        |
| **Load Balancers**        | Healthy Host Count            | Number of healthy backend hosts.                      | Ensure availability of backend servers.             |
|                           | Request Distribution          | Distribution of requests across hosts.                | Monitor load balancing effectiveness.               |

### 4. **Operational Metrics**
| **Component**            | **Metric Name**               | **Description**                                       | **Purpose**                                          |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **Monitoring Tools**      | Alert Resolution Time         | Time taken to resolve triggered alerts.               | Evaluate incident response efficiency.              |
|                           | Alert Volume                  | Number of alerts triggered in a specific timeframe.   | Monitor alert trends and optimize alert thresholds. |
| **CI/CD Pipelines**       | Build Success Rate            | Percentage of successful builds.                      | Identify issues in the deployment process.          |
|                           | Deployment Frequency          | Number of deployments per day/week/month.             | Measure release agility.                            |

### 5. **Security Metrics**
| **Component**            | **Metric Name**               | **Description**                                       | **Purpose**                                          |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **Authentication**        | Failed Login Attempts         | Number of failed login attempts.                      | Detect potential brute force attacks.               |
|                           | Token Expiry Rate             | Number of tokens expiring unexpectedly.               | Identify token mismanagement issues.                |
| **Vulnerability Scanners**| Vulnerabilities Detected      | Number of vulnerabilities identified in scans.        | Monitor security posture and compliance.            |

### 6. **Network Metrics**
| **Component**            | **Metric Name**               | **Description**                                       | **Purpose**                                          |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **Network Traffic**       | Bandwidth Utilization         | Amount of inbound and outbound data.                  | Monitor network capacity and identify anomalies.     |
|                           | Packet Loss                   | Percentage of packets lost during transmission.        | Detect network issues affecting reliability.         |
| **Firewalls**             | Blocked Traffic               | Number of blocked connections.                        | Identify potential security threats.                |

### 7. **User Experience Metrics**
| **Component**            | **Metric Name**               | **Description**                                       | **Purpose**                                          |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **Customer Feedback**     | Net Promoter Score (NPS)      | Customer satisfaction rating.                         | Measure overall user satisfaction.                  |
|                           | Complaint Rate                | Percentage of users submitting complaints.             | Monitor dissatisfaction trends.                     |

## Acceptance Criteria
- Should identify metrics for each system component, categorized by functionality.
- Should ensure metrics are actionable, with defined purposes for monitoring.
- Should provide a basis for implementing dashboards and alerts.

### Gherkin
Given a system component,
When monitoring its performance,
Then the metrics should include those outlined in this documentation to ensure comprehensive visibility and actionability.

This documentation establishes a robust foundation for monitoring all system components, enabling effective management and optimization of service health and performance.
